newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Pick Metrobank - Sun Hung Kai.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pick Metrobank - Sun Hung Kai.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities recommended on Wednesday a switch to Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co Inc from Philippine National Bank (PNB).
The recommendation came after PNB workers went on strike on Tuesday after they failed to reach an agreement with the bank on their demand for a wage hike.
Besides the labour problem, Sun Hung Kai said, PNB still suffers from a relatively poor asset quality with its past due ratio at 4.3 percent against the industry's 3.3 percent.
"Also, PNB's growth potential is limited by its relatively low loans/deposit ratio of 69 percent (compared to Metrobank's 95 percent)," the Sun Hung Kai report said.
"Thus, we recommended a switch to Metrobank."
